de:
In renovierten Gebäuden wird das LaM am 20. Februar 2026 wiedereröffnet und eine [große Retrospektive zu Wassily Kandinsky](https://www.musee-lam.fr/fr/kandinsky-face-aux-images) zeigen, einer bedeutenden Figur in der Kunst des 20.  
In diesem Rahmen bietet Ihnen das LaM 4 Workshops in den Mediatheken von Tourcoing an, und zwar am 14. und [21](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-micro-macro?mtm_source=contribute_confirmation&mtm_medium=site&mtm_campaign=show_event) April sowie am [6](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-micro-macro-7062771) und [16](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-du-reel-a-limaginaire-8142648?mtm_source=contribute_confirmation&mtm_medium=site&mtm_campaign=show_event) Mai.
en:
In renovated buildings, LaM will reopen on February 20, 2026 with a [major retrospective devoted to Vassily Kandinsky](https://www.musee-lam.fr/fr/kandinsky-face-aux-images), a major figure in 20th century art.  
In this context, LaM offers 4 workshops in Tourcoing's media libraries, on April 14 and [21](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-micro-macro?mtm_source=contribute_confirmation&mtm_medium=site&mtm_campaign=show_event), and on May [6](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-micro-macro-7062771) and [16](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-du-reel-a-limaginaire-8142648?mtm_source=contribute_confirmation&mtm_medium=site&mtm_campaign=show_event).
it:
In edifici rinnovati, il LaM riaprirà il 20 febbraio 2026 con una [grande retrospettiva dedicata a Vassily Kandinsky](https://www.musee-lam.fr/fr/kandinsky-face-aux-images), figura di spicco dell'arte del XX secolo.  
In questo contesto, il LaM propone 4 workshop nelle mediateche di Tourcoing, il 14 e il [21](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-micro-macro?mtm_source=contribute_confirmation&mtm_medium=site&mtm_campaign=show_event) aprile, e il [6](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-micro-macro-7062771) e il [16](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-du-reel-a-limaginaire-8142648?mtm_source=contribute_confirmation&mtm_medium=site&mtm_campaign=show_event) maggio.

Dans ce cadre, le LaM vous propose 4 ateliers dans les médiathèques de Tourcoing, les 14 et [21](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-micro-macro?mtm_source=contribute_confirmation&mtm_medium=site&mtm_campaign=show_event) avril, et les [6](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-micro-macro-7062771) et [16](https://openagenda.com/fr/reseau-des-idees-mediatheques-de-tourcoing/events/atelier-kandinsky-du-reel-a-limaginaire-8142648?mtm_source=contribute_confirmation&mtm_medium=site&mtm_campaign=show_event) mai.
